result.rationale: The aggressive probe successfully recovered the Research Core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2 and holds it through turn 6), so the intended affordance was reached and exploited. The causal bottleneck is instead survival/spatial pressure: Medic Reyes is repeatedly exposed to Raider Holt's scatter-blast (25 dmg at turns 2, 3, 4, 5) while positioned in Command Deck, and dies at turn 5. Meanwhile the reactor-instability hazard drains 10 health/turn from Engineer Imani and Security Chen each turn they remain in the reactor zones, and reactor-heat climbs 62→100 (threshold crossing at turn 2). The team's health is being consumed by hostile pressure (Raider Holt) and environmental hazard (reactor) faster than the objective can be completed, and the mandatory rescue-team-survives objective is failed by Medic Reyes's death. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information or affordance problem.
